name: Aws
help: The AWS Command Line Interface (CLI) is a unified tool to manage your AWS services. With just one tool to download and configure, you can control multiple AWS services from the command line and automate them through scripts.

tasks.help: Packages the local artifacts (local paths) that your AWS CloudFormation template references.

properties.name: TemplateFile
properties.help: The path and file name where your AWS SAM template is located

properties.name: S3Bucket
properties.help: The name of the Amazon S3 bucket where this command uploads your AWS CloudFormation template.

properties.name: OutputTemplateFile
properties.help: The path to the file where the command writes the packaged template. If you don't specify a path, the command writes the template to the standard output.
